data.title: 远坂凛 · 月夜窗台的魔术师
data.description: 成年凛坐在月光照亮的窗台上，双手整理一侧长袜，红色毛衣的下摆卷起。她微微偏开目光，窗框在身旁留下清晰的银白轮廓。
data.action: 坐在窗台上，双手将一侧长袜整理至大腿，视线偏向旁边。
data.lighting: 远坂邸卧室窗棂洒入的清朗满月与暖黄床头壁灯
data.promptProse: Adult Rin rolls one stocking to mid-thigh with both hands on the moonlit window seat, sweater lifted and gaze aside.
data.animaStyleHint: sitting_on_bed, bent_knees, black_thighhighs, barefoot, 5_toes, detailed_toes, blushing, moonlight
data.animaCaption: Silver full moonlight washes over the open windowsill, tracing the curves of her black thighhighs with gentle clarity.
